info.title: cashwerk API
info.description:
Official cashwerk REST API for third-party integrations.

**Authentication:** Include your API key via the `X-API-Key` header, or use an OAuth2 Bearer token.

**Rate Limits:** Responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

**Response format:** All successful responses are wrapped in:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": <payload>, "message": "<info>", "statusCode": 200 }
```

**Errors:** All errors return:
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "<error>", "statusCode": 4xx }
```
